instruction: Download all the songs from my Spotify album library that I have liked.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) with no answer. The concrete set of songs is only known at runtime, so the problem uses a representative set: two songs that are both in an album of the album library and liked (the targets), one library-only song and one liked-only song as distractors. Membership facts (in-album-library, liked-song) are world state in :init; the agent only learns them via spotify.show_album_library and spotify.show_liked_songs, modeled by the nullary knowledge flags album-library-scanned / liked-songs-scanned that gate spotify-download-song. download-song additionally requires both membership facts, so distractors can never be downloaded, matching the evaluation (exactly the intersection of library song_ids and liked song_ids, nothing removed). Because supervisor-complete-task must literally require every goal condition and the goal is a universal over task entities, the two target songs are declared as domain constants (the generic domain cannot otherwise name them without quantification); the remaining entities are problem objects. Pagination in the reference solution is collapsed into one call per lookup API. The username comes from supervisor.show_profile (profile-known gates login). spotify-login forbids re-login with an already held token.
